# Menus and action groups

Resolved structure of the main menu and the most important context menus / toolbars. Each line shows the label, the action id in backticks, and default shortcuts (Windows `$default` / macOS). `---` is a separator; ▸ marks a submenu (popup group); non-popup groups are inlined in place, as IntelliJ renders them.
